origin.title: MotoGP URT 3
origin.label_method: Original baked glyph pixels, no resampling. Only second-digit cells change; nearby carbon restores the removed ink.
origin.calibration: Absolute RPM follows printed ticks, including changed 16 and 18. 19000 uses the remaining native capped sweep after 18, keeping the needle clear of the gear bubble.
origin.shader: ps.1.1: saturate(2*texture.rgb*vertex.rgb), texture.a*vertex.a. Source sprite RGB128 is neutral; original PNG RGB retained.
origin.lights: Original lights_enabled=false; no shift lights fabricated.

restoration.method: Reviewed face; original logical geometry and background opacity; verified shared needle and glyph restoration.
restoration.note: Visual restoration, not pixel-identical donor artwork. Existing 16/18 labels remain.
